slides.title: Guests sleeping on your couch? Finds for a no-panic guest kit.
A vacuum-seal bag for bedding
slides.body: Guest sheets and blanket packed flat in one bag. No hunting the linen closet.

slides.title: A clear basket for toiletries
slides.body: Toothbrush, mini shampoo, a towel. Guests grab it, no questions.

slides.title: A plug-in night light
slides.body: They can find the bathroom in the dark. One less 3am text.

slides.title: A foldable luggage rack
slides.body: Their bag stays off the floor, so the room still feels tidy.

slides.title: A label for the wifi password
slides.body: Stick it on the basket. Nobody asks you twice.

slides.title: A good guest room is one bin that's ready when you aren't.
